name: Davia: AI RPG in Living Worlds

ios.desc:
Looking for an RPG where you can try anything and the world actually reacts? In Davia, you become one character inside a living world that keeps moving, pushes back and remembers what you did.

ONE CHARACTER, A REAL PLACE IN THE WORLD
Pick a game and a role: a Roman general, a Sengoku daimyo, a revolutionary in Paris or an explorer in a world you have never seen. You start with a position, relationships, resources and limits.

TRY ANYTHING, EARN EVERYTHING
Type what you want to attempt, in your own words. The world answers the situation: a negotiation can fail, a march takes time and an alliance can change your future. Nothing is handed to you.

A MAP THAT CHANGES
Every game is anchored on a living map. Armies march, borders move, territories change hands, and other characters pursue their own aims even when you are not looking.

MEET THE CHARACTERS
Talk with the people who live in the world. Learn what they want, negotiate, persuade or betray, and build relationships that last.

YOUR JOURNAL REMEMBERS
Every event is recorded. Come back to your game and see what your decisions changed.

PLAY TOGETHER
Join a multiplayer game with friends and inhabit different characters in the same shared world.

OVER 5,000 WORLDS
Historical, modern and fantasy settings: Rome, Sengoku Japan, the French Revolution, the modern world and many more created by the community.

If you enjoy AI alternate-history games such as Pax Historia, Davia lets you live that history from the inside, as one character.

Download Davia and choose who you become.

Terms of Use: https://davia.ai/legal/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://davia.ai/legal/privacy-policy
Support: contact@davia.ai

show_hn.title: Show HN: Davia – Visual AI roleplay with image-based conversations

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

We’re Ruben, Afnan, and Theo, and about a month ago we started working on a beta webapp for a more visual roleplay experience.

We felt that roleplay works best when it feels like a real conversation, not like reading a chat log. So we focused on a phone-exchange format, where characters message you as if they’re on the other end of your phone and can send images that evolve with the story and react to what’s happening.

Since the first beta, we’ve been building around a few core ideas:

- Native memory for every character, so they keep context and remember past interactions
- No ads, no interruptions, just the experience
- Unlimited character creation, to build as many worlds and characters as you want

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/davia-visual-ai-chat-platform/id6757320079
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.davia.app

It’s still early, and we’re actively iterating.

We’d love to hear what you think and what you’d improve in this kind of experience. :)
